notes.title: Introducing the Fallen Seeds Deluxe Edition and Collector Pack!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667993/36b6461a5bf9b52a1689c7ded6ee40c9b3b07050.jpg[/img]

Dear friends!

We are excited to announce that two new editions of our game Fallen Seeds are now available: the Deluxe Edition and the Collector Pack!

Both bundles include:

[list]
[*] The full version of the game Fallen Seeds
[*] The game soundtrack
[*] The Artbook
[*] The Artbook Extra
[/list]

The Deluxe Edition allows you to purchase all content at once if you don't own any elements of the bundle yet. The Collector Pack is for those who already have some of the bundle elements and want to complete the collection. Both options come with a valuable discount for purchasing the whole set.

Thank you for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Fallen Seeds Artbook Extra – Third and Final DLC Supporter Pack!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667993/9f0c2382c5a7490dfc060f16ed1950322157553f.jpg[/img]

Dear friends,

We are excited to announce the release of the third and final DLC Supporter Pack – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3033690/Fallen_Seeds_Artbook_Extra/]Fallen Seeds Artbook Extra[/url]! This artbook offers a unique insight into the game's universe, featuring early concepts in a different style, characters not included in the first part of the game, fan art, promo art, and special illustrations created specifically for this collection.

Like the main artbook, the Fallen Seeds Artbook Extra is available in PDF format and includes a set of UHD PNG images that can be used as desktop wallpapers.

By purchasing this artbook, you not only get a behind-the-scenes look at the game’s creation but also support the developers, helping us continue working on the second part of Fallen Seeds.

Key Features:

[list]
[*] Early concepts in a different style
[*] Characters not included in the first part of the game
[*] Fan art and promo art
[*] Special illustrations created for the artbook
[*] A set of PNG images for use as desktop wallpapers
[*] All illustrations created by the project artist Alice Makoveeva
[/list]
Thank you for your support and enjoy the artwork!

notes.title: Fallen Seeds Artbook Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667993/ae0aa9aa86a247df7ddb5c2482dd4da2c68d8810.jpg[/img]

Dear friends,

We are excited to announce the release of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3033680/Fallen_Seeds_Artbook/]second DLC Supporter Pack[/url] - the Fallen Seeds Artbook! This artbook is a collection of character concepts, backgrounds, and illustrations that you can see directly in the game, as well as their sketches and early versions. It's a unique opportunity to peek behind the scenes of game creation and see how key elements evolved throughout development.

The DLC includes the artbook itself in PDF format, along with a set of UHD PNG images that can be used as desktop wallpapers or otherwise. By purchasing this artbook, you not only get to enjoy beautiful illustrations but also support the developers and show your appreciation for their hard work.

Key Features:

[list]
[*] Character, background, and illustration concepts from the game
[*] Sketches and early versions of art materials
[*] A set of PNG images for use as desktop wallpapers
[*] All illustrations created by the project artist Alice Makoveeva
[/list]

Don't miss the chance to be part of our story and support the further development of the game!

notes.title: Fallen Seeds: Welcome Our First DLC with Soundtrack!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

We are excited to announce that our first [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012390/Fallen_Seeds_Soundtrack/]DLC Supporter Pack[/url] with the soundtrack for Fallen Seeds is now available on Steam! This is a wonderful opportunity to support our team and enjoy the fantastic music from the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667993/77027c8cb7085b49e5f26f351670011062042841.jpg[/img]

[b]What’s included in the DLC:[/b]

[list]
[*] 24 unique tracks, created specifically for the game by composer Danil Bazhenov with the participation of the "Shuttle Team 311-X" and Vilena Sokolova, who voiced Ada.
[*] High-quality audio files in FLAC and MP3 formats, so you can enjoy all the nuances of the music.
[*] Music in various genres: indie, fusion, oriental motifs, and electronic rock – all for a full immersion into the atmosphere of Fallen Seeds.
[/list]

[b]Why you should get this Supporter Pack:[/b]

[list]
[*] Support our team, help us develop the project, and create new games.
[*] Get access to the soundtrack before anyone else – it will be available on streaming platforms only in two to three weeks.
[/list]

Don't miss the chance to become a part of our community and get unforgettable musical impressions!

Thank you for your support and enjoy the music!

tags.feature: DLC Supporter Pack with the soundtrack for Fallen Seeds is now available on Steam!
